answer: Every participant stakes 25 POA for twelve epochs and must finish five separate jobs, each inspected by three unrelated reviewers selected at random with no shared funder. Two matching approvals pass a job; confirmed collusion burns 15% of the stake. History stays public: a canyon separates new identities from privileged work, unusual wander across accounts triggers graph review, and violet status is earned only after verified tenure. Each extra identity needs its own stake, job trail, and independent reviewers.
